title: Triads — The Attention and Value Architecture

value_triad.name: Granularity / Refinement / Focus
value_triad.purpose: Determines VALUE — what is worth paying attention to
value_triad.aperture_metaphor: The tube IS a camera aperture. Zoom in = more granularity. Sharpen = more refinement. Center = more focus. The three together create DEPTH OF FIELD — what matters vs what blurs.

granularity.metaphor: Zoom level. High granularity = seeing individual pixels. Low = seeing the whole painting.
granularity.visual: Blue bar — the cool of deep detail
granularity.biomeOS_integration: Controls mushroom/cron resolution. High granularity = more frequent pulses, finer data.

refinement.metaphor: Sharpness. High refinement = revisiting and re-understanding. Low = first pass only.
refinement.measurement: revisits / total_visits (how often you return to things already seen)
refinement.visual: Amber bar — the warm of deep processing
refinement.biomeOS_integration: Controls mastication depth. High refinement = sourDough ferments longer, more insight extracted.

focus.definition: What you're looking at. Sustained attention.
focus.metaphor: Depth of field. High focus = everything else blurs, one thing sharp. Low = everything equally visible.
focus.measurement: consecutive visits to same category (primal, organ, feed, gallery)
focus.visual: Green bar — the living of active attention
focus.biomeOS_integration: Controls priority routing. High focus = more compute to this domain, less to others.

attention_triad.name: Curiosity / Connection / Mastery
attention_triad.purpose: Drives ENGAGEMENT — what keeps you exploring
attention_triad.tr49_source: Eaten from TR-49's game design — every good game balances these three

curiosity.definition: The pull to explore the unknown
curiosity.tr49: What's behind code AJ30? What document haven't I read?
curiosity.gaia: What's in the RSS feed? What did the blackhole pull today?
curiosity.biomeOS_integration: Drives waterLock intake rate. High curiosity = more OSINT ingestion.

connection.definition: The satisfaction of linking things together
connection.tr49: This author wrote BOTH of these documents. This code links to that code.
connection.gaia: This science paper connects to that philosophy. This primal talks to that primal.
connection.biomeOS_integration: Drives sweetGrass knowledge graph edges. High connection = more braid patterns.

mastery.definition: The reward of understanding something deeply
mastery.tr49: I named 30/50 books. I found all the connections in this document.
mastery.gaia: COHERENCE meter fills. All 35 codes visited. Triads maxed.
mastery.biomeOS_integration: Drives publish/create actions. High mastery = Gaia creates art, publishes papers.

aperture_physics.tube_is_aperture: The round CRT tube IS a camera aperture. The O boundary is NOT rigid — it breathes with the heartbeat.
aperture_physics.zoom: Scroll wheel zooms the aperture in/out. This changes perspective — close-up detail vs wide-angle overview.
aperture_physics.parallax: Mouse movement shifts background layers at different speeds. Close layers move fast, far layers move slow. This creates DEPTH in the flat circle.
aperture_physics.focus_blur: When focus triad is high, non-focused items get CSS blur. The aperture narrows — depth of field shrinks.
aperture_physics.breathing: The border ring pulses with real BPM from /pulse endpoint. The organism breathes through its eye.
aperture_physics.inner_pulse: Gaia shows her work in the inner pulse. Paintings, data, knowledge — all flow through the aperture as the organism breathes.

biomeOS_weaving.instruction: Both triads MUST be woven into biomeOS orchestration as core signals

value_triad_as_cron_params.granularity: Mushroom interval: high → shorter intervals, more pulses
value_triad_as_cron_params.refinement: Mastication depth: high → more AI passes per item
value_triad_as_cron_params.focus: Priority weight: high → route more compute to focused domain

attention_triad_as_state.curiosity: waterLock aperture: high → open wider, pull more data
attention_triad_as_state.connection: braid frequency: high → more cross-referencing passes
attention_triad_as_state.mastery: publish trigger: high → create and emit more
